description: This file is a test script that analyzes Python source files within a specific directory to verify that cache calls inside async functions are properly made with async methods. It uses AST parsing to identify async functions and investigate their cache-related calls, ensuring adherence to async programming practices.

classes.name: AsyncCacheCallVisitor
classes.description: AST NodeVisitor subclass that traverses a Python AST to identify async functions and cache-related calls within them, storing their names and the call line numbers.

methods.name: visit_AsyncFunctionDef(self, node)
methods.description: Handles visiting async function definitions, storing the name of the current async function and initializing a list for cache calls.

methods.name: visit_Call(self, node)
methods.description: Visits call nodes within the AST, checks if the call is within an async function, and if the call relates to cache operations, records the full call path and line number.

methods.name: List[str] get_python_files(directory: str)
methods.description: Collects all Python files from a specified directory, excluding special files like __init__.py.

methods.name: Dict[str,List[Tuple[str,int]]] analyze_file(file_path: str)
methods.description: Parses a given Python file and uses AsyncCacheCallVisitor to identify cache calls within async functions.

methods.name: test_router_strategy_async_cache_calls()
methods.description: Main test function that scans relevant files in the directory, analyzes them for cache calls within async functions, and asserts all such calls are made with async methods.
